name: Prospector Ryedol
summary: South of Hammertoe's Digsite, Prospector Ryedol watches over the Explorers' League's work in the Badlands. He searches for dwarven relics and keeps hope alive amid troggs and beasts.

sections.title: Watching Over the Digs
sections.body: From a hill south of Hammertoe's Digsite, Prospector Ryedol directs the Explorers' League's work. The dry valley holds ancient titan secrets and traces of dwarven heritage, yet troggs, coyotes, and drakes threaten the expeditions. Dark Iron dwarves have stolen dwarven gear, so Ryedol sends out efforts to recover it. The League has lost much in these wastes, and he searches ruined outposts for signs of hope.

faq.answer: Ryedol is a dwarven field researcher for the Explorers' League. His camp sits on a high hill overlooking Hammertoe's Digsite in the eastern Badlands, where he directs salvage and recovery work.

faq.q: What is Ryedol doing in the Badlands?
faq.answer: Ryedol supports the Explorers' League's archaeological work in the Badlands. Dark Iron dwarves and troggs have overrun or compromised nearby digsites, so he works with travelers to recover relics, find lost tools, and learn what happened to his fellow dwarves.
Ryedol's Hammer is given for recovering his Lucky Pick from the Dark Iron dwarves who attacked Hammertoe's Digsite. The stolen item is his pick, not the hammer.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you see Ryedol carry Ironforge's drive to uncover the origins of your people, even in Khaz Modan's harshest reaches.
As an Alliance traveler crossing the Badlands, you find a friendly face in Ryedol and urgent work supporting the Explorers' League.
